notes.title: We’re reaching the final phase!
notes.notes: [p]Our team is hard at work on the project![/p][p][/p][p]We want to give a huge thanks to everyone who has played the demo so far and shared valuable feedback. Rest assured, we’re carefully reviewing everything we receive and working on making the game better based on your input.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and your support as we continue preparing for the launch of [b]Operator Unknown[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]It’s coming very soon[/b] 🙃🔪[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472452/6a83896e430187f2744fa097e57c3fbf6403be0c.png"][/img][/p]
